description: Retry classification beyond Dagster's built-in RetryPolicy — retry on HTTP 429 + 5xx but fail immediately on 400/401/403/404. Classifies raised exceptions against configurable rules (HTTP status codes, exception classes) and re-raises as Dagster RetryRequested (retryable) or Failure (permanent). Wraps a Python callable, shell command, or one-off HTTP call. Configurable backoff + jitter + max attempts.

outputs.description: One asset whose materialization is the retry-wrapped compute. Metadata includes attempts + classification + http_status.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run; for compute kind 'shell' the command is run once per partition in the range with its own DAGSTER_PARTITION_KEY (python-kind compute receives the context and must handle context.partition_keys itself). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured. This asset returns a MaterializeResult (no IO manager), so single_run needs no range-aware IO manager.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

asset_name.description: Dagster asset name. Required when NOT using `wraps:` (inherited from inner in wraps mode).
asset_name.label: Asset Name

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Optional. Passed as second positional arg to the compute callable.

compute.label: Compute
compute.description: Compute config: {kind: python|shell|http, ...kind-specific}. python: python='mod:fn'. shell: cmd=[...] or 'cmd string' + timeout_seconds. http: method/url/headers/body/params.

retry_rules.label: Retry Rules
retry_rules.description: Ordered classification rules. First match wins. Kinds: http_status (transient_codes+permanent_codes), exception_class (transient+permanent dotted lists).

llm_fallback.label: LLM Fallback
llm_fallback.description: OPTIONAL. LLM classifies unrule-matched errors as transient/permanent. Shape: {model=gpt-4o-mini, api_key_env_var=OPENAI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds=10}.

rate_limit.label: Rate Limit
rate_limit.description: OPTIONAL. Sliding-window cap on retries. Shape: {max_events=3, window_seconds=60, mode=fail|wait, key=null}. key defaults to asset_name.

circuit_breaker.label: Circuit Breaker
circuit_breaker.description: OPTIONAL. Cross-materialization circuit breaker. Shape: {threshold=5, observation_window_seconds=300, cooldown_seconds=60, key=null}. State persists per Python process.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Smart Retry
